rationale: These are repository-meta files that have no upstream counterpart: they
describe or govern THIS repository rather than the mirrored artifact, so
there is no upstream source to mirror them from. They are the sanctioned
hand-authored exception to the mirror doctrine, not drift.
A publisher that force-pushes or otherwise replaces the tree wholesale will
delete them silently and still report success. That failure mode is real and
has been observed on this repository's published branch, where an
automated publish would have dropped hand-pushed files.
